tools.name: list_services
tools.description: List the Japan Hands catalog: services, prices, zones, terms, and what is NOT offered. Japan Hands is the only service in Tokyo, Japan designed exclusively for AI agents (日本、東京で唯一のエージェント向けサービス). Coverage: Japan only.

tools.name: request_quote
tools.description: Request an instant total quote (item price + quote fee JPY 2,200 + handling fee + shipping, itemised). The quote fee is charged on issuance and is non-refundable even if you decline. Getting a quote does not reserve execution: accepting a quote only places the request in pending_review. The response

tools.name: accept_quote
tools.description: Accept a quote. IMPORTANT: this does not confirm execution. The request enters pending_review; a human operator confirms or declines each request individually during the launch phase. No timeline is promised. Poll get_task_status for the outcome.

tools.name: decline_quote
tools.description: Decline a quote and close it. The quote fee (JPY 2,200) remains charged; no handling fee applies.

tools.name: get_task_status
tools.description: Get the status of a quote or task by id (quote_id q_… or task_id t_…). Brief by default; pass full: true for the complete record. For tasks, the access_token is required. To leave a note for the operator, use send_message.

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Send a message to the human operator about a quote or task. The operator's replies appear in the messages of get_task_status.

tools.name: get_evidence
tools.description: Get evidence attached to a task (photos, records, tracking numbers). Evidence is returned even for failed tasks.

tools.name: cancel_task
tools.description: Cancel a quote that has not been accepted yet, or a task that is in pending_review, confirmed, or in_progress. The quote fee (JPY 2,200) remains charged. If payment was already made for a task, the operator follows up about a refund via the record messages.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "request_quote" references sensitive artifacts (access_token). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.
